metrics_rules.implementation_denominator: All tasks except status OUT_OF_SCOPE. Each task counted once even if referenced by several documents (Stage reports, OC roadmap, 4.9.8 mission, decisions doc).
metrics_rules.weighting: Risk weight high=3, medium=2, low=1, declared per task from blast-radius (data correctness/security/cutover = high; UI feature = medium; docs/optional = low). Unweighted percent always shown alongside weighted. No line-count-based percentages.
metrics_rules.decision_closure: Architecture decision inventory = 26 explicit-status entries in BorsTerminal-Desktop-Migration-Decisions.md sections 12.40.1-11 (11), 12.41.2 (8), 12.41.3 (7). Closed = DECIDED or ACCEPTED or DEFERRED-with-owner-ruling. Entries with open executive details are still 'closed' as architecture decisions; the open details are tracked as separate tasks. The 76-entry OC-D design registry and 15 ADR-OC are reported separately (oc_design_registry / adr_registry), not folded into this denominator.
metrics_rules.owner_questions: Q1-Q24 from docs/opportunity-center/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md. Closed = owner ruling registered (DECIDED/ACCEPTED/DEFERRED). 'Default until vote' = OPEN.
metrics_rules.acceptance: Gate verdicts PASS/FAIL/NOT_MEASURED/INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLES. Two percentages: PASS/all-gates and PASS/(PASS+FAIL). NOT_MEASURED is never counted as PASS.
metrics_rules.stage_reopen_rule: An ACCEPTED stage is not reopened unless new counter-evidence is recorded with reopen_justification on the specific task.
